CREATE OR ALTER FUNCTION [dbo].[ArtifactNgSiteNavigation](@id int) RETURNS XML WITH RETURNS NULL ON NULL INPUT BEGIN RETURN ( SELECT name, url, 'Menu_AT' + cast(id as varchar(15)) as menuID, 0 as feature, case when @@NESTLEVEL > 24 then null else dbo.ArtifactNgSiteNavigation(id) end as items FROM ( select T.ObjectID as ID, T.Name, AUrl.[Url] as [Url] from AssetType T outer apply ( select IT.SubjectID from IntersectType IT inner join [Predicate] P on IT.Object = T.Object and IT.ObjectID = T.ObjectID and P.ID = IT.PredicateID and P.Type = 3 ) IT cross apply [dbo].[GetAssetTypeUrlById](T.ID) AUrl where IT.SubjectID = @id and T.ObjectID <> @id and T.Object = 'ArtifactType'
) BG order by name FOR XML PATH('nav'), TYPE ) END
